doc.onClick: called when this button is clicked
doc.modifier: the [Modifier] to be applied to this button
doc.enabled: controls the enabled state of this button. When `false`, this component will not respond to user input, and it will appear visually disabled and disabled to accessibility services.
doc.shape: defines the shape of this button's container, border (when [border] is not null), and shadow (when using [elevation])
doc.colors: [ButtonColors] that will be used to resolve the colors for this button in different states. See [ButtonDefaults.buttonColors].
doc.colors.containerColor: the container color of this [Button] when enabled.
doc.colors.contentColor: the content color of this [Button] when enabled.
doc.colors.disabledContainerColor: the container color of this [Button] when not enabled.
doc.colors.disabledContentColor: the content color of this [Button] when not enabled.
doc.elevation: [ButtonElevation] used to resolve the elevation for this button in different states. This controls the size of the shadow below the button. See [ButtonElevation.shadowElevation].
doc.elevation.defaultElevation: the elevation used when the [Button] is enabled, and has no other [Interaction]s.
doc.elevation.pressedElevation: the elevation used when this [Button] is enabled and pressed.
doc.elevation.focusedElevation: the elevation used when the [Button] is enabled and focused.
doc.elevation.hoveredElevation: the elevation used when the [Button] is enabled and hovered.
doc.elevation.disabledElevation: the elevation used when the [Button] is not enabled.
doc.border: the border to draw around the container of this button
doc.contentPadding: the spacing values to apply internally between the container and the content
doc.interactionSource: an optional hoisted [MutableInteractionSource] for observing and emitting [Interaction]s for this button. You can use this to change the button's appearance or preview the button in different states. Note that if `null` is provided, interactions will still happen internally.
doc.content: The content displayed on the button, expected to be text, icon or image.
